messages:
nora: Quick heads-up 11 opening a tiny docs PR to tighten the troubleshooting flow for transient 429s/timeouts and an opt-in fallback pattern. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422
adrian: Nice. Please: 1) define 'grace window' in one sentence, 2) add a 3-step ops checklist, 3) include two minimal SDK snippets (py/js). Keep it short.
ops-bot: Ops request: include a synthetic repro command so support can trigger a reproducible 429 locally. Also call out KV cache warmness implications.
nora: Will do. Snippets will be inline small blocks; larger examples linked at bottom. Also adding "Known limitations": streaming may not be preserved when switching models mid-request.
adrian: Billing check: confirm whether tokens are billed at executed model(s). If multiple requests run during retries, billing reflects each execution. Call that out plainly.
ci-bot: PR #1422 created by nora. lint OK. link-check pending. preview deployed at 2026-03-24T09:30:00Z.
nora: Adding a labeled "synthetic repro" line for the ops checklist. Will merge after billing confirms wording. Thanks all :thumbsup:
